# 🚀 Deployment / Local Distribution Checklist

- [ ] Build command and compiler version recorded.
- [ ] Source commit identified.
- [ ] Applicable tests executed and evidence linked.
- [ ] Documentation and license checks passed.
- [ ] Private contact data excluded from the distributable package.
- [ ] Runtime data-file location documented.
- [ ] Backup and recovery instructions reviewed.
- [ ] Export output behavior reviewed.
- [ ] Known limitations listed.
- [ ] Artifact checksum recorded if a binary is distributed.

This project currently has local executable distribution only.
